citation: Tumasian RA, Harish A, Kundu G, Yang JH, Ubaida-Mohien C, et al. (2021). Skeletal muscle transcriptome in healthy aging. Nature Communications 12:2014.
differential_method: PyDESeq2 0.5.4 with design ~ sex + condition; condition = young (age<=30, n=8) vs old (age>=60, n=22)

consensus_thresholds.rationale: Re-derivation with n=8 young is severely underpowered; only 14 genes pass strict padj<0.05. Using padj<0.10 + |lfc|>0.3 to recover meaningful biology (CDKN1A, CDKN2B, EDA2R, OSTN). Quality of hits is high (textbook senescence markers); quantity is reduced by sample-size constraint.

table_provenance: Derived 2026-05-05 by backend/scripts/run_geo_deseq.py from GEO supplementary file GSE164471_GESTALT_Muscle_ENSG_counts_annotated.csv.gz. NOT identical to Tumasian 2021 paper output (paper used different software versions, full age-encoding model, additional covariates). For RL-loop-grade consensus voting only.
limitations: Modest sample size (n=39 in two-group); reduces power for small effect sizes.
role_in_consensus: Primary case-control aging comparison for healthy community-dwelling adults. Strong reference for v2 P1_up/P2_up.
